gloss: to give a firm warning in advance

definitions.gloss: to give a firm warning in advance; to make someone promise
definitions.explanation: To warn someone firmly beforehand so that they will not do something, or to pin them to a promise; literally, to drive in a nail so that something cannot move.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遅刻|ちこく}しない→遅刻する：22282_chikokusuru⟧よう{釘|くぎ}を{刺|さ}す。
examples.english: To warn someone firmly not to be late.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「⟦{無駄遣|むだづか}い→無駄遣い：07310_mudazukai⟧⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{釘|くぎ}を{刺|さ}された。
examples.english: My mother warned me not to waste my money.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{社外|しゃがい}→社外：17992_shagai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{絶対|ぜったい}→絶対：00435_zettai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話|はな}さない→話す：00467_hanasu⟧よう⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{釘|くぎ}を{刺|さ}した。
examples.english: Before the meeting, the department head warned everyone never to tell anyone outside the company.

notes:
The warning comes before anything has gone wrong, which is what separates it from scolding. The passive {釘|くぎ}を{刺|さ}される (to be warned) is very common.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜ないよう(⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧){釘|くぎ}を{刺|さ}す: to warn someone not to ...
- 「…」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{釘|くぎ}を{刺|さ}す: to warn, quoting the words

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{念|ねん}を{押|お}す→念を押す：33951_nenwoosu⟧: to make sure, to remind — gentler, a check rather than a warning
- ⟦{警告|けいこく}→警告：02696_keikoku⟧: a warning, the general and formal word
